subtitle.en: The English proficiency test disguised as a candlelit dinner
subtitle.pl: Test z angielskiego przebrany za kolację przy świecach
subtitle.ru: Тест по английскому под видом ужина при свечах

correct: Your date blushes. Smooth grammar is so attractive.
The violinist plays a little faster. Nice!
Your date leans in. Correct answers are their love language.
Somewhere, a cupid high-fives another cupid.
wrong: Awkward silence. Even the waiter looks away.
Your date checks their phone. Ouch.
A single cricket chirps in the corner of the restaurant.
Your date's smile freezes like the ice in their drink.
The violinist hits a wrong note out of sympathy.

description.en: You mostly pointed at the menu and smiled. Cute, but your date thinks you might be a mime. Keep practising!
description.pl: Komunikacja głównie przez pokazywanie palcem menu i uśmiech. Urocze, ale randka podejrzewa, że jesteś mimem. Ćwicz dalej!
description.ru: Общение в основном жестами и улыбками над меню. Мило, но твоя пара подозревает, что ты мим. Тренируйся дальше!

description.en: You can order food and say nice things about the weather. A promising start, but no second date just yet.
description.pl: Umiesz zamówić jedzenie i powiedzieć coś miłego o pogodzie. Obiecujący początek, ale na drugą randkę jeszcze za wcześnie.
description.ru: Ты умеешь заказать еду и сказать что-то милое о погоде. Многообещающее начало, но до второго свидания пока далеко.

description.en: You held a real conversation! There were a few tangled noodles, but your date laughed at your jokes.
description.pl: Prawdziwa rozmowa! Kilka makaronów się poplątało, ale randka śmiała się z twoich żartów.
description.ru: Настоящий разговор! Пара макаронин запуталась, но твоя пара смеялась над твоими шутками.

description.en: Confident, fluent and charming. Your date is already planning what to wear next Friday.
description.pl: Pewność siebie, płynność i urok. Randka już planuje, co założyć w przyszły piątek.
description.ru: Уверенно, бегло и обаятельно. Твоя пара уже решает, что надеть в следующую пятницу.

description.en: Idioms, inversions, subtle irony - your date is swooning. Wedding bells can be heard faintly in the distance.
description.pl: Idiomy, inwersje, subtelna ironia – randka mdleje z zachwytu. W oddali słychać ciche dzwony weselne.
description.ru: Идиомы, инверсии, тонкая ирония — твоя пара тает. Вдали уже слышны свадебные колокола.

description.en: Flawless. Poets write about people like you. Your date just proposed - in perfect English, naturally.
description.pl: Bezbłędnie. Poeci piszą o takich ludziach jak ty. Randka właśnie się oświadczyła – oczywiście nienaganną angielszczyzną.
description.ru: Безупречно. О таких, как ты, пишут поэты. Твоя пара только что сделала предложение — разумеется, на безупречном английском.

questions.scenario: You arrive at the restaurant. Someone with a red rose waves at you.
questions.question: Hi! ____ you Alex?

explanation.en: With 'you' we always use 'are'.
explanation.pl: Z „you” zawsze używamy „are”.
explanation.ru: С «you» всегда используется «are».

questions.scenario: The waiter appears with a tiny notebook and a huge moustache.
questions.question: I ____ like the mushroom risotto, please.

explanation.en: 'I would like...' is the polite way to order.
explanation.pl: „I would like...” to uprzejmy sposób zamawiania.
explanation.ru: «I would like...» — вежливый способ сделать заказ.

questions.scenario: Your date asks: "What do you do in your free time?"
questions.question: Which answer keeps the conversation alive?

explanation.en: The question asks about hobbies - the other answers are a great way to stay single.
explanation.pl: Pytanie dotyczy hobby – pozostałe odpowiedzi to świetny sposób, żeby zostać singlem.
explanation.ru: Вопрос про хобби — остальные ответы отличный способ остаться без пары.

questions.scenario: You try to impress your date with your cultural life.
questions.question: Yesterday I ____ a really romantic film.

explanation.en: 'Yesterday' = finished time in the past, so we use the past simple: 'watched'.
explanation.pl: „Yesterday” to zakończony czas w przeszłości, więc używamy past simple: „watched”.
explanation.ru: «Yesterday» — завершённый период в прошлом, поэтому нужен past simple: «watched».

questions.scenario: Your date has been talking about their ex for 25 minutes. Time to change the topic.
questions.question: Anyway... ____ we order dessert?

explanation.en: 'Shall we...?' is used for suggestions. And for emergency topic changes.
explanation.pl: „Shall we...?” służy do składania propozycji. I do awaryjnej zmiany tematu.
explanation.ru: «Shall we...?» используется для предложений. И для экстренной смены темы.

questions.scenario: You take a sip of the house wine.
questions.question: This wine is ____ than the one at my cousin's wedding.

explanation.en: 'Good' is irregular: good - better - the best.
explanation.pl: „Good” jest nieregularne: good – better – the best.
explanation.ru: «Good» — неправильное прилагательное: good – better – the best.

questions.scenario: Things are going well. You decide to be brave.
questions.question: If you ____ free on Saturday, we could go dancing.

explanation.en: First conditional: if + present simple, ... could/will + verb.
explanation.pl: Pierwszy okres warunkowy: if + present simple, ... could/will + czasownik.
explanation.ru: Условное предложение первого типа: if + present simple, ... could/will + глагол.

questions.scenario: Your date arrives 40 minutes late. You stay calm. Ish.
questions.question: No problem! I've only been waiting ____ seven o'clock.

explanation.en: 'Since' + a point in time, 'for' + a period of time.
explanation.pl: „Since” + moment w czasie, „for” + okres czasu.
explanation.ru: «Since» + момент времени, «for» + отрезок времени.

questions.scenario: Oops! Your date spills red wine on the white tablecloth.
questions.question: Don't worry, the stain will ____ out with a bit of salt.

explanation.en: A stain 'comes out' when it disappears after cleaning.
explanation.pl: Plama „comes out”, kiedy schodzi po czyszczeniu.
explanation.ru: Пятно «comes out», когда оно отстирывается.

questions.scenario: Your date says: "I'm not a big fan of horror films."
questions.question: "____ I. Let's watch a rom-com instead!"

explanation.en: To agree with a negative sentence using 'be', we say 'Neither am I'.
explanation.pl: Żeby zgodzić się z przeczeniem z „be”, mówimy „Neither am I” (ja też nie).
explanation.ru: Чтобы согласиться с отрицанием с «be», говорим «Neither am I» (я тоже нет).

questions.scenario: Your date shows up dressed like a movie star. You are wearing a hoodie.

m.scenario: Your date shows up in an elegant evening gown. You are wearing a hoodie.

f.scenario: Your date shows up in a tuxedo. You are wearing a hoodie and slippers.

questions.question: If I ____ it was this fancy, I would have dressed up!

explanation.en: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.
explanation.pl: Trzeci okres warunkowy: if + past perfect, would have + past participle (III forma).
explanation.ru: Условное предложение третьего типа: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.

questions.scenario: The bill arrives. Your date reaches for their wallet.
questions.question: No, no, put that away - this one's ____ me.

explanation.en: 'It's on me' means 'I'm paying'. Very romantic. Slightly expensive.
explanation.pl: „It's on me” znaczy „ja stawiam”. Bardzo romantyczne. Trochę kosztowne.
explanation.ru: «It's on me» значит «я угощаю». Очень романтично. Слегка дороговато.

questions.scenario: It's suddenly midnight. Your date says: "Wow, time flies when you're having fun!"
questions.question: What does your date mean?
options: The evening passed very quickly because it was enjoyable.
They want to go home immediately.
There is an insect near the clock.
They are late for a flight.

explanation.en: 'Time flies' = time passes quickly, usually because you're enjoying yourself. Good sign!
explanation.pl: „Time flies” = czas szybko leci, zwykle dlatego, że dobrze się bawisz. Dobry znak!
explanation.ru: «Time flies» = время летит, обычно потому что тебе хорошо. Хороший знак!

questions.scenario: At the end of the evening, you walk your date to the taxi.
questions.question: I'm really looking forward to ____ you again.

explanation.en: 'Look forward to' is followed by a gerund (-ing), because 'to' is a preposition here.
explanation.pl: Po „look forward to” stawiamy gerund (-ing), bo „to” jest tu przyimkiem.
explanation.ru: После «look forward to» нужен герундий (-ing), потому что «to» здесь предлог.

questions.scenario: You tell your friends about the date the next day.
questions.question: Hardly ____ sat down when a violinist appeared at our table.

explanation.en: After negative adverbs like 'hardly' at the start, we use inversion: 'Hardly had we...'.
explanation.pl: Po przysłówkach przeczących typu „hardly” na początku zdania stosujemy inwersję: „Hardly had we...”.
explanation.ru: После отрицательных наречий вроде «hardly» в начале предложения нужна инверсия: «Hardly had we...».

questions.scenario: Your date tastes the soup and politely says it's "a bit lukewarm".
questions.question: What is wrong with the soup?

explanation.en: 'Lukewarm' means only slightly warm - perfect for baths, terrible for soup.
explanation.pl: „Lukewarm” znaczy letni – idealne do kąpieli, fatalne dla zupy.
explanation.ru: «Lukewarm» значит «едва тёплый» — идеально для ванны, ужасно для супа.

questions.scenario: Your best friend asks how the date went. You grin: "We really hit it off!"
questions.question: What does this mean?

explanation.en: To 'hit it off' = to get along well instantly. No violence involved.
explanation.pl: „Hit it off” = od razu świetnie się dogadać. Bez przemocy.
explanation.ru: «Hit it off» = сразу найти общий язык. Никакого насилия.

questions.scenario: You are bragging about your date to your grandmother.
questions.question: Not only ____ an amazing cook, but they also write poetry.

m.question: Not only ____ an amazing cook, but she also writes poetry.

explanation.en: 'Not only' at the start of a clause triggers inversion: 'Not only is she...'.
explanation.pl: „Not only” na początku zdania wymusza inwersję: „Not only is she...”.
explanation.ru: «Not only» в начале предложения требует инверсии: «Not only is she...».

f.question: Not only ____ an amazing cook, but he also writes poetry.

explanation.en: 'Not only' at the start of a clause triggers inversion: 'Not only is he...'.
explanation.pl: „Not only” na początku zdania wymusza inwersję: „Not only is he...”.
explanation.ru: «Not only» в начале предложения требует инверсии: «Not only is he...».

explanation.en: 'Not only' at the start of a clause triggers inversion: 'Not only are they...'.
explanation.pl: „Not only” na początku zdania wymusza inwersję: „Not only are they...”.
explanation.ru: «Not only» в начале предложения требует инверсии: «Not only are they...».

questions.scenario: Looking at the bill, your date murmurs: "Well, that was a tad extortionate."
questions.question: What is the tone of this comment?
options: Ironic understatement - it was ridiculously expensive.
Genuine praise for the fair prices.
A formal complaint to the manager.

explanation.en: 'A tad' (a little) + 'extortionate' (outrageously overpriced) = classic British understatement.
explanation.pl: „A tad” (odrobinę) + „extortionate” (zdzierczo drogi) = klasyczne brytyjskie niedopowiedzenie.
explanation.ru: «A tad» (чуточку) + «extortionate» (грабительски дорогой) = классическое британское преуменьшение.

questions.scenario: You planned a picnic for the second date. Then the sky opened.
questions.question: Had it not been for the rain, we ____ the picnic in the park.

explanation.en: Inverted third conditional: 'Had it not been for X, we would have + past participle'.
explanation.pl: Trzeci okres warunkowy z inwersją: „Had it not been for X, we would have + III forma”.
explanation.ru: Условное предложение третьего типа с инверсией: «Had it not been for X, we would have + past participle».

questions.scenario: Your date's love letter contains 14 metaphors about your eyes and 9 about the moon.
questions.question: The letter was sweet, but a little too ____ for my taste.

explanation.en: 'Saccharine' = excessively sweet or sentimental. 'Salubrious' = healthy, 'sanguine' = optimistic.
explanation.pl: „Saccharine” = przesłodzony, ckliwy. „Salubrious” = zdrowy, „sanguine” = optymistyczny.
explanation.ru: «Saccharine» = приторный, слащавый. «Salubrious» = полезный для здоровья, «sanguine» = оптимистичный.
